title: qcom-ptool platform
description: The flashable configurations of one board. Each flavor entry is one configuration, built into <name>/<storage-id>/; name defaults to this file's name.

board.description: Path, relative to this file, of the board.

contents.description: HLOS and flashing part of every configuration's contents metadata, including where contents.xml is written ('location'), laid over the board's SoC part: keys override, 'common' entries are appended. A flavor entry's own 'contents' replaces it. The result is validated against contents.schema.json.

flavors.description: Flavors, each one flashable configuration of the board.

oneOf.description: Path, relative to this file, of a flavor.

flavor.description: Path, relative to this file, of a flavor.

name.description: Output name of this configuration; defaults to this file's name.

contents.description: This configuration's contents metadata, replacing the platform's; laid over the board's likewise.
